sources.title: Japan Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Grenada basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page expressly identifies Japanese nationals and distinguishes the short visitor exemption from work and longer stays.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 日本国籍者は、就労目的を除き、3か月以内の短期滞在については、査証の取得は免除されます。

sources.title: Japan Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Jordan basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page expressly identifies Japanese passports and describes the distinct arrival-issued Jordan visa at airports or land-border offices.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 日本のパスポートで入国する場合、入国時、空港または陸路の国境事務所において90日の滞在許可を無料で取得できます。

sources.title: Japan Ministry of Foreign Affairs: North Macedonia basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page identifies the bilateral exemption arrangement and confines it to Japanese non-commercial visits of up to three months.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 観光等の非営利活動目的による3か月以内の滞在については、査証の取得が免除されます。

sources.title: Japan Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Trinidad and Tobago basic safety data
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: Japan's live Foreign Ministry traveller page records the Japanese embassy's direct confirmation from Trinidad and Tobago's Foreign Ministry that Japanese passports need no visa for short visits of 90 days or less.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 日本のパスポート所持者が90日以下の短期滞在目的で入国する場合、ビザは不要との回答でした。

sources.title: Iraq Ministry of Foreign Affairs: obtaining an entry visa upon arrival
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Iraq
sources.officialityEvidence: Iraq's Foreign Ministry consular guidance expressly names Japan in its arrival-visa cohort, describes border issuance and separately advises pre-travel eVisa use from 1 March 2025.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Japan ... [is] granted a visa to Iraq upon arrival through the border crossings.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Grenada short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Japan's current Foreign Ministry guidance exempts Japanese nationals from Grenada visas for short visits of up to three months other than work.
conditions: Ordinary Japanese passport holder, non-work short stay up to three months, with the stated passport validity, onward ticket, funds and accommodation.
Work, stays over three months, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Japan's current Foreign Ministry guidance permits Japanese passport holders to receive a free 90-day Jordan arrival visa at an airport or land-border office.
conditions: Ordinary Japanese passport holder; arrival-issued permit for up to 90 days, with at least six months' passport validity and two blank visa pages.
Extension, work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: North Macedonia short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Japan's current Foreign Ministry guidance records the bilateral exemption for Japanese non-commercial visits to North Macedonia of up to three months.
conditions: Ordinary Japanese passport holder, tourism or another non-commercial stay of up to three months.
Employment, stays over three months, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Trinidad and Tobago short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Japan's current Foreign Ministry guidance records Trinidad and Tobago Foreign Ministry confirmation that Japanese passport holders need no visa for short stays of up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Japanese passport holder, short visitor stay of up to 90 days, with the stated passport validity, onward ticket, funds and accommodation.
The separate online arrival and departure declaration is an entry form, not an ETA. Work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Japanese ordinary passports: Iraq visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Iraq's current Foreign Ministry guidance names Japanese passports in its visitor visa-on-arrival cohort.
conditions: Ordinary Japanese passport holder; the visa is issued at Iraqi land, air or sea border crossings and is stated as valid for 60 days.
Iraq separately advises, but does not require in place of this route, pre-travel eVisa use. Work, residence, special passports, Iraqi-origin treatment and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Iraq eVisa, but Iraq's current Foreign Ministry expressly grants Japanese passports a visa at arrival; its separate eVisa advice does not eliminate border issuance.
